en.title: One visa, three different clocks
en.note: Track all of them per person, in one place
en.focal: Overstays can mean fines and re-entry bans
en.alt: Diagram of the three clocks on one visa: entry validity (enter before this date), maximum stay (how long you may remain), and entry count (single or multiple entries), with a note that Schengen adds a fourth, the rolling 90/180 window, and that overstays can mean fines and re-entry bans
en.caption: A visa is not one date. It is three separate clocks, and sometimes a fourth.
